title: Materialize CFA3 Shared Ray/Path Tracing Fabric
goal: Provide one provider-neutral shared ray/path tracing semantic and compatibility fabric for all relevant CFA3 applications, preserving CPU-only viability and explicit NVIDIA/AMD/Intel paths without creating a new execution authority.
requirements: Bind to existing CAP-127 rather than create a capability.
Use one shared core across applications; application-local tracing cores are forbidden.
Preserve a CPU software path and 0..N accelerator topology.
Never silently select or substitute a GPU/backend.
Engine Selection remains selection-intent authority; HRB remains device placement/reservation/lease authority.
Neural denoise routes through Model Router and CAP-163 boundaries.
Donor use is pattern/reference only with no code copy or runtime dependency.
Static materialization does not claim Current Host runtime PASS.
